findings.title: NULL pointer dereference in set_pict_type() via unit->content_ref
findings.message: In set_pict_type(), when determining the picture type for a VVC frame, the code iterates over the CodedBitstreamUnit array of the current access unit and, for every unit whose type is <= VVC_RSV_IRAP_11 (i.e. a slice NAL unit), directly dereferences unit->content_ref as an H266RawSliceHeader* without first checking that content_ref is non-NULL. The CBS layer does not guarantee that content_ref has been populated for every unit with a slice NAL unit type at this point in decoding (e.g. malformed/truncated bitstreams can produce slice-type units whose content has not been parsed/attached yet). When content_ref is NULL, IS_I(rsh) and IS_B(rsh) dereference a NULL H266RawSliceHeader pointer, causing a NULL pointer dereference crash. This was found by OSS-Fuzz (clusterfuzz testcase for the VVC fuzzer).
findings.suggestion: Check that unit->content_ref is non-NULL before treating it as a valid H266RawSliceHeader pointer and dereferencing it via IS_I/IS_B macros.

ground_truth.root_cause: Missing NULL check on unit->content_ref before dereferencing it as a parsed slice header structure; the code assumed that any CBS unit with a slice-like NAL unit type would always have its content_ref populated, which is not guaranteed for malformed/incompletely parsed bitstreams.

must_cover.reason: Primary location of finding: NULL pointer dereference in set_pict_type() via unit->content_ref
